title: Total lamp power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total power consumed by all lamps operating normally (22 classes × 6 lamps × 40 W).

title: Generator output power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the generator's output power, accounting for transmission line losses and transformer power conservation.

title: Generator EMF calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the generator's electromotive force, accounting for its internal resistance and output voltage/current.

title: Transmission line current
description: Important: Correctly applies transformer ratios and power conservation to find the current in the transmission line.

title: Transmission efficiency
description: Important: Correctly calculates efficiency as the ratio of useful lamp power to generator output power.

title: Analysis for halved lamps
description: Important: Correctly determines that the generator's output power is not halved when lamps are halved, due to changed line losses.

title: Transformer voltage relationships
description: Optional: Correctly applies step-up and step-down transformer ratios to relate voltages across the system.

title: Ignoring transformer losses
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes non-ideal transformer losses or uses incorrect power conservation (e.g., P_primary ≠ P_secondary for ideal transformers).

title: Line loss miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect current (e.g., lamp current) or voltage to calculate power loss in the transmission line.

title: Internal resistance omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the generator's internal resistance when calculating its electromotive force.
